text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. My classmate's victory party is
going to be
fantastic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Since it's going to be held in a
classroom, it might
be nice to suggest
some decorative ideas.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what type of cake would be
best for the
occasion? Ordering one
from a famous shop
would be nice, but
decorating a cake together
with
everyone sounds delightful too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, in front of the station earlier, I

happened to be handed a flier for a
cake shop.
Perhaps I should have a
proper look at it right
away...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan is so preoccupied with
planning the
party that she ends up
skipping training.
